approach: The cause is read from code, not measured, because the snapshot has no records. `StageMinutes.producer` is the sum of producer invocation wall times (`role_minutes`, status.rs). A producer's own cargo commands wait for a build slot inside that invocation. `producer_loop` (crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs:370) calls `loop_replay` after every parsed report, and the replay takes a producer-class slot for two workspace builds. When the loop is about to send the report back for another reason, the producer then edits the tree and that measurement is thrown away (`LoopReplay::covers` needs the same tree). With the default of one check slot and two concurrent jobs, those wasted holds queue the other job's producer. The fix is one focused change in `producer_loop`. Compute whether the report has a non-replay problem and a send-back is still available, using exactly the complement of the break at producer.rs:446. In that case skip `loop_replay` and set it to None. Otherwise call it as before. The report that leaves the loop is therefore always measured, and the hold at verification reuses it. Tests are added to the existing in-loop replay module. The note docs/design/producer-slowdown.md and a CHANGELOG entry state the cause and the size, labeled an estimate. Files outside the brief's deliverable list: the brief's Files line is `crates/`, so producer.rs and tests.rs are within it. Criterion 4 requires the diff to touch "the code on the cause path and its tests", and the cause path is producer.rs. status.rs only sums recorded durations, and editing it would hide the time. I read `limits_changed_files` (briefs.rs:146-222) against criterion 4's text. The `only` branch needs `may change` within 6 words, and the text has none. The other branches need `no file`, `no other file`, `test only` or `production unchanged`, and none appears. So `allowed_paths` (briefs.rs:115) returns None and no scope check flags producer.rs or tests.rs.

decisions.choice: Skip `loop_replay` on a report that has a non-replay problem while a send-back is still available; run it on every other report.
decisions.reason: The tree changes after a send-back, so that measurement cannot be reused (`LoopReplay::covers`, run/mod.rs:182). Skipping removes the thrown-away slot hold and two builds. Safety is kept because the report that leaves the loop is always measured, and the hold at verification (mod.rs:2129) still backstops. This removes the cause, not a timeout or a number.

steps: Read crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs lines 170-250 and 325-515, run/mod.rs lines 160-185 and 2250-2410, and the in-loop replay tests in run/tests.rs (1700-2110) with the helpers `run_loop`, `script_editing`, `marker_rules_while`, `seed_accepted_jobs` and `take_slot_soon`. Find the value of `PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS` and `SCOPE_SEND_BACKS`.

In producer_loop, after `unmet`, `unchanged`, `outside`, `gate` and `mirror_drift` are computed and before the replay call, compute `let other_problems = !unmet.is_empty() || !unchanged.is_empty() || gate.is_some() || !outside.is_empty() || !mirror_drift.is_empty();` and `let scope_slot_free = !outside.is_empty() && scope_send_backs < SCOPE_SEND_BACKS;`. Compute `let will_send_back = other_problems && !(send_backs >= PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS && !scope_slot_free);`. If `will_send_back`, set `loop_replay = None`; otherwise `loop_replay = self.loop_replay(ctx, &snapshot)?`. Reuse the same `scope_slot_free` at the break so the two cannot drift apart. Keep `left_criteria` and the redaction order. Add a short root-cause comment and update the doc comment at line 173.

In run/tests.rs add `run_loop_gap` (the body of `run_loop` plus a `gap_runs: usize` parameter, with `#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]`), where `run_loop` calls it with 0. The gap script wraps `script_editing` and, while the producer run count is at most `gap_runs`, empties the `criteria_check` of the producer's report. Add test (a) `in_loop_replay_is_skipped_on_a_report_that_is_sent_back_for_another_reason` (gap of 1 run; asserts `prompts.len() == 2`, `candidate_calls == 10`, no in-loop line before the `producer   sent back` line, one after, state Landed).
